summary: Nightly: Method + Wowhead refetched, 0 of 160 letters moved; Mythicstats period 1082 (2 Mage rows retired); WCL raid partial; 2 takes distilled; Icy Veins + Archon walled.

sources.detail: All six registered pages are Cloudflare-blocked from this runner. One bounded direct GET per page with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + Sec-Fetch-* + Sec-CH-UA + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests) returned HTTP 403 with a 1,892-1,895-byte Cloudflare interstitial ("Attention Required", cf-error, Ray ID) on every one of the six URLs. No proxy, challenge solve or replay was attempted. This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (attemptedAt 2026-09-26T14:45:18.649Z), which records http 403 and a null resolved date for all six icyveins pages. Nothing was parsed, so no letter moved and neither `snapshot` (still 2026-09-22) nor the page-stated `published` dates (2026-08-29 / 08-30 / 09-01) were touched. Stored rows stay at 80 across both brackets, above the 60 floor.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 163,420 (raid) and 170,071 (M+) bytes. Parsed from the page's own `<div class="tier__tier …">` blocks — S/A/B/C once on the raid page and twice on the M+ page — with every entry accepted by ROSTER MATCH on its `data-original-title`, never by container position; that is what rejects the M+ page's dungeon-difficulty blocks, whose 8 entries (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) were the only unmatched values on either page. Per-bracket counts printed and reconciled BEFORE the merge against the 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank roster shape: raid 40 (S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6), M+ 40 (S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4) = 80 rows, 0 roster rows unmatched, 0 duplicate specs. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Era-verified from the BODY, not the metadata: both pages' meta/og description still carries the stale "The War Within Season 3" boilerplate while the visible page-desc reads "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" (raid) and "Mythic+ content and dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2" — body over title, so seasonVerified stays s2 — and Devourer is present. Each page's own "Last Updated" line was re-read live (raid "10th August 2026", M+ "13th August 2026"), matching both the committed registry and this run's pre-agent published-evidence receipt, so `published` is unchanged and only `snapshot` advances.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76-346 KB each. Parsed the documented way: unescape `\/` -> `/` across the whole document FIRST, then find the `[tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list]` block and read `[tier-label …]<TIER>[/tier-label]` with tolerant whitespace, taking specs from their `[spec-badge=<spec>-<class>]` kebab slugs (which sidesteps the two-word-class split). Anchoring on `WH.markup.printHtml(` was deliberately avoided — the raid-healer decoy call is the known zero-row trap. Per-page row counts printed and reconciled against the roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27 DPS (A 8 / B 14 / C 5) + 7 healer (S 1 / A 3 / B 3) + 6 tank (S 1 / A 3 / B 2), M+ 27 DPS (S 1 / A+ 2 / A 7 / B 14 / C 3) + 7 healer (S 1 / A 3 / B 1 / C 2) + 6 tank (S 1 / A 3 / B 2) = 80 rows, 0 slugs unmatched. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Era-verified per page from the body: "Midnight Season 2" appears 18-49 times per page against 0-4 retrospective "Midnight Season 1" mentions in per-spec prose, the raid pages name the Venomous Abyss, and Devourer DH is present in both DPS lists. Each page's JSON-LD `dateModified` was re-read live — raid 2026-08-31 x3, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ healer 2026-09-10, M+ tank 2026-09-01 — identical to the committed `published` values and to this run's pre-agent published-evidence receipt, so `published` is unchanged and only `snapshot` advances.

Fetched successfully but upstream has not re-snapshotted, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Both JSON API calls returned HTTP 200 with no headers, proxy or auth: `manifest.json` (353 B) reports `snapshotDate` 2026-09-15 — unchanged for a third week, 11 days old against the source's own clock — and `rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json` (162,376 B) returned the usual 44 blocks. The rankings file was fetched and DIFFED rather than short-circuited on the manifest, because a pinned snapshotDate is not evidence the data is frozen (the 2026-08-04 incident): selecting `categoryType` in the whitelist {dps, hps, tank} PLUS `sortField === "lowerBound"` PLUS `keyRange === undefined` gave exactly 3 blocks and 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, and all 40 `lowerBound` values and `numberOfCharacters` counts are byte-identical to stored at the 1-decimal stored precision. Merged anyway per the no-change-detector policy; specs.json is unchanged by it. asOf remains the SOURCE's 2026-09-15, never the run date. 11 days is past `maxAgeDays` 8, so the heartbeat will red — that red IS the honest signal that upstream has stalled.

The agent holds no WCL credentials and made no WCL request of any kind. The 47 stored "Median … (Mythic" rows keep their 2026-08-10 date and values untouched, above the 30 floor.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent `fetch-stable-metrics.mjs` step, not by this agent: `metrics-fetch/evidence.json` (checkedAt 2026-09-26T14:44:50.931Z) records all three meta pages at HTTP 200 on the first attempt (71,302 / 42,311 / 40,911 B), a complete 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank parse (40 rows, no omitted specs) and `sourceAsOf` 2026-09-17 read from the page's own `<time datetime>` (dateBasis source-time-datetime), not from the fetch. Applied by merging `metrics-fetch/updates.json` through apply-metrics.mjs and nothing else — no second parser was written. All 40 merged values are identical to stored. `node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs` passes against the receipts and git HEAD. The source's own update date is 9 days old and did not move today, so the coverage date stays 2026-09-17: partial, not success. That is 4 days past `maxAgeDays` 5, which the heartbeat will report.

All 27 DPS specs requested from `chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk/…` with up to 3 attempts each. 24 returned charts; 3 returned the 76-byte `{"status": "error", "message": "No standard chart with these values found."}` body on every attempt — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, the same three absent since the 2026-09-03 MID2 adoption and the same three SimC has no MID2 profile for, so this is upstream absence and not a parse failure. `simc_settings.ptr` compared EXPLICITLY against the string "0" (it is truthy in JS); `simc_settings.tier` read off each chart rather than assumed, and it is MID2 on all 24, so the pool stays tier-uniform and SIM_TIER_REQUIRED is satisfied. The 12.1.5 wholesale-adoption hold does not apply this run: `PHASES.livePatch` and `LABEL_FLIP_DUE` are both null and this run's own evidence has 12.1.5 still PTR-only (Blizzard's 12.1.5 topic is titled "PTR Development Notes" and PTR Kith'ix raid testing is still being scheduled), so current charts merge as normal. `asOf` taken per chart from its own `timestamp`: all 24 read 2026-09-23. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 24 profiles on any target count; the merge ran and left specs.json byte-identical. Upstream has not re-simmed since 09-23, so the coverage date cannot advance — partial, 3 days old, still inside `maxAgeDays` 8. 24 rows clears the 15 floor with no row drop.

`MID2_Raid.txt` fetched HTTP 200, 1,446,217 B, and it HAD a `DPS Ranking:` block, so the HTML fallback was not needed. Era-verified off the header BUILD string, never the visible Highcharts version: `SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-09-24/69933, git build HEAD a69b06905b, no-networking)`. The git hash advanced from the stored run's 1e0751c16d, which is the honest explanation for the movement — a new sim run on the SAME WoW hotfix build 69933. 45 ranking lines; the `Raid` aggregate row skipped; profile names mapped by LONGEST PREFIX with hyphens allowed in the spec token, giving 24 DPS specs at their best hero variant (the 7 unmapped names are all tank profiles and are correctly not ingested; Balance Druid, Augmentation and Devastation Evoker have no MID2 profile upstream, matching bloodmallet's absent set). 23 of 24 values moved and every move is sim noise: the largest is Unholy Death Knight 269,878 -> 268,689, -0.44%, and nothing else exceeds ±0.15%, far below `maxValueMovePct` 0.6, so no value_move_ack is needed. asOf stays the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-24 because the WoW build it simulates did not move, which leaves the coverage date 2 days old — partial, not success, and inside `maxAgeDays` 10.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent `fetch-stable-metrics.mjs` step; the receipt records status `success`. `https://mythicstats.com/period/latest` resolved to `/period/1082` at HTTP 200 (215,345 B) — a NEW weekly period (last run held at 1082's predecessor) — and the section parse is structurally sound: role subtotals Ranged 30.1 / Melee 29.8 / Tank 20 / Healer 20 summing to 99.9, matching the page's own printed totals within a rounding step, so this is the representation SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence widget. 38 rows landed (25 DPS / 7 healer / 6 tank). Mage|Fire and Mage|Frost are omitted from the chart this period and were RETIRED rather than zeroed, per the owner decision of 2026-09-25: their stored shares (0 and 0.1) are at or under the 0.5-point `MYTHICSTATS_RETIRE_MAX_SHARE` bound, so `updates.retire` removed exactly those two rows (40 -> 38, a 5% drop, well inside `maxRowDropPct` 0.25) and both specs now render blank rather than carrying a share the period did not print; either returns by itself when a later period lists it. 34 of the 38 remaining values moved with the new period — all are percentage shares under the 100-unit `minValueMagnitude`, so the value-move guard does not apply — and the changed rows take the fetch date 2026-09-26 while the page still publishes no update timestamp (`sourceAsOf: null`, `dateBasis: observed-undated-source`), which is what advances the coverage date to today. Merged only `metrics-fetch/updates.json` through apply-metrics.mjs; `node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs` passes.

Only `checkedAt` advanced in data/official-notes.json; `node src/check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD` passes with 0 unresolved and the 27 removal tombstones preserved. Recorded as leads for the owner, not acted on: Blizzard's 12.1.5 Kith'ix PTR raid-testing posts and the "Midnight Season 3 Dungeon Pool Preview", both cycle-opening events that require an owner configuration change.

All three transcripts were read in full and resolved: 2 distilled, 1 transcript-verified-skipped, 0 left waiting. AutomaticJak's WglElpwZpZ4 yielded one Discipline Priest M+ take (sentiment buff: the dungeon-only Atonement buff makes Disc playable in keys and reachable for the 1%, Voidweaver over Oracle, but explicitly not meta — binary healing, weak personals, bad on the gather, Holy Priest still above it), superseding his 2026-09-22 stream-VOD M+ read and leaving his 09-22 raid take live as a different lens. His Unholy DK, Holy Priest, Restoration Druid and Devourer reads are outside his declared spec scope and were deliberately NOT written as takes. Obli's CtKL4uOPUIk is a Blightfall PLAY guide — one +17 walkthrough of hero-talent decision-making with no cross-spec claim — and went to `skipped[]` with its reason, the same disposition as his 09-25 hero-talent comparison precedent. 3 new in-scope videos queued, keyword-filtered as the nightly requires because Supadata requests are metered: izen peDmFfrUZeg (an explicit Unholy-DK-now-S-tier M+ meta read, the metaNotes lane), Dalaran Gaming GWaPC3CyfwI (12.1.5 PTR Demon Hunter rework / Rogue buffs) and Tactyks QsYJEKOp-dA (12.1.5 PTR Kith'ix raid testing; he is raid-scope only, being the Method M+ list author). Deliberately NOT queued and recorded in the log instead: two guide-shaped uploads (Obli's 3-minute Blightfall guide, AutomaticJak's "3 Disc Raid Secrets"), Supatease's PvP/Classic-framed uploads, and the WoW: Forever beta content that dominates the window. The remaining unseen videos stay UNSEEN rather than marked seen — they are a budget cut, not a durable dismissal. No tier moved: creator opinion is never tier data.

The deterministic pre-agent collector reports `brackets["wcl-leaderboard-raid"].status: "partial"` — 276 median rows against a 200 minimum, with 43 empty/sparse cuts and 1 invalid cut — and `landed["wcl-leaderboard-raid"].rows: 276`, so the row is partial, not success. The invalid cut is Arcane Mage on encounter 3497, rejected by the collector because a returned ranking run timestamp was in the future relative to the observation instant (2026-09-26T15:05:24.057Z > 14:42:55.674Z); the 43 sparse cuts are spec/boss pairs with fewer than the 10-entry minimum (Survival Hunter 8, Fire Mage 2, Fury Warrior 5 on The Twin Fangs among them). Those cuts kept their previous observations unchanged. No partition supersession was reported: the recipe's pinned zone 53 / partition 1 / difficulty 5 / size 20 is still the newest reviewed configuration, and the raid bracket stays pinned there until the reviewed switch. The agent holds no WCL credentials and made no WCL request; the collector's merge was already applied to data/specs.json and data/wcl-coverage.json before this agent started, and nothing was recomputed or edited. `node src/check-wcl-metrics.mjs --manifest data/run-manifest.json` confirms the merged rows match the trusted collection with historical and failed/sparse cuts retained exactly. These are per-encounter first-page medians of up to 100 ranked entries (minimum 10) in which entries may repeat characters — not population medians, never pooled across encounters. Collection date 2026-09-26.
